errors.evidence: The description of the dark gray line (average net bid) is completely wrong. It starts at ~5.05 (not 4.9), does not rise (it is flat and then decreases), and ends at 4.5 (not 4.8). The description confuses attributes from the other lines.

errors.text_span: die über den gesamten Bereich der x-Achse bei etwa 5,0 Eurocent / kWh relativ konstant bleiben
errors.evidence: Describing the purple line (average electricity generation costs) as 'relatively constant' is a major over-generalization and factually incorrect. The line starts at 4.9, is flat until a bonus of 0.2, then rises significantly to ~5.25 at a bonus of 0.4, and then remains constant at that new, higher level. The description misses this key step-increase.
